title: Candlepin Bowling
tagline: Small ball, slim pins, and every fallen pin stays: use the wood.
description: New England candlepin bowling with real pin physics in a lit 3D alley. Slide, aim, pick your pace and curve, and use the wood: fallen pins stay on the lane. Six rivals, sixteen Wood Puzzles, two players and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Drag along the lower lane to slide the ball; touch the pin deck to aim.
Choose Soft, Firm or Fast and add curve with the arrows, then press ROLL.
Three balls a frame, ten frames; fallen pins stay on the lane as wood.
Strike scores 10 plus the next two balls; a spare 10 plus the next ball.
Use the wood: bank the ball off lying pins into the ones still standing.
